address: Conrad Abu Dhabi Etihad Towers Hotel, West Corniche, Abu Dhabi
bio: Its contemporary styling, views of the harbour, well-choregraphed service and good food make this Lebanese restaurant a favourite of many. The core of the menu is classic Lebanese, but the kitchen works hard here to impress, especially when it comes to presentation and the subtle addition of modern touches to some dishes. Whilst the main menu is a little more concise than many places, it is supplemented by a very useful selection of fixed price menus.
